[SWS_CM_10541] Remote access control on consuming triggers
Upstream requirements:
RS_AP_00158
⌈
If a remote subject subscribes to an
trigger
of a service interface, but there exists
no
ComTriggerGrant
that
• references the subscribing remote subject in the role
remoteSubject
and
• references a
ProvidedApServiceInstance
in the role
serviceInstance
and
• references the
ServiceEventDeployment
in the role
serviceDeployment
that in turn references the subscribed
trigger
.
then Communication Management shall drop the subscription request.
⌋
